content:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — high auth failure rate on /v1/login (eu-west-1). Alert: auth_fail_rate > 12% for last 5m. PD incident: PD-4521, runbook: /runbooks/auth-spike.

alice-oncall: I'm on it, starting triage. Paging SREs.

ben-sre: seeing a burst of 401s from a tight set of source ASNs. Top srcs: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.44, 203.0.113.0/25.

carla-netops: confirmed. Connection patterns look like automated probes — high concurrency, repeated username attempts. No upstream infra errors.

ben-sre: quick KQL to verify: ``search namespace=auth logs "POST /v1/login" | stats count() by src_ip | sort -count | head 50`` — shows same IP blocks.

carla-netops: I'm going to flip a WAF tarpit on the offending /v1/login path for those CIDRs. Preparing rule payload.

carla-netops: WAF action (running):
```
POST https://internal-admin.waf/v1/rules
{
  "match": {"path": "/v1/login", "ips": ["198.51.100.0/24","203.0.113.0/25"]},
  "action": "tarpit",
  "reason": "automated credential probe"
}
```

alice-oncall: :thumbsup: add a short TTL (15m) and monitor. If side-effect on legit traffic, rollback.

dave-platform: I'm going to apply a quota-slice for anonymous tokens — reduce per-token QPS slice to 0.2 for medium tier clients from eu-west-1. Patch posted: ``/configs/quotas -> {"anon_qps_mult":0.2, "scope":"eu-west-1"}``.

frank-ops: rolling out a rate-limiter at edge (rl-id: rl-772) with aggressive 429 on second failed attempt per IP for /v1/login. Deploying now.

emily-cx: CX note — we already have 6 incoming tickets referencing login failures, two customers on SRE contracts flagged urgent. I'm drafting an outbound note: "We are mitigating elevated authentication failures; short-term rate controls in place; monitoring and will update in 30m." Want approval for that copy.

alice-oncall: approve the copy, add a line: "No account data was exfiltrated / no successful bulk logins detected."

emily-cx: added. Sending to affected customers now, referencing PD-4521.

gina-security: suggest enabling CAPTCHA challenge (edge) for clients with >10 failed logins in 5m and flagging accounts with abnormal patterns for hold. Also persist failed-login fingerprint to K/V to detect distributed attempts.

carla-netops: CAPTCHA rule is low-impact for legit users. Enabling: ``edge.waf.rules.add({challenge:"captcha", threshold:10, path:"/v1/login"})``.

ben-sre: after initial WAF tarpit + edge limiter + quota slice, auth failure rate dropped from 12.3% to 3.1% in 7m. Still watching.

frank-ops: metrics: request rate from the top CIDR down 86%, successful login rate for legitimate clients back to baseline. No backend CPU spikes.

gina-security: locking out any accounts with >50 failed attempts from single device fingerprint for 24h; will coordinate with CX for reauth flow.

alice-oncall: documenting actions in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PD-4521. Handing off to ben for 3-hour follow-up window. Ben will escalate if we see rebound.

ben-sre: taking 3h watch. I'll keep the quota slice and tarpit TTL rolling until traffic normalizes. If failure rate <1% for 30m, start staged rollback: first remove tarpit, then relax quota.

emily-cx: customers updated. No SLAs breached so far, but pockets of impact for third-party SSO integrations. CX will open dedicated support threads for those customers.

alice-oncall: thanks team. If anything changes ping @oncall-escalation and update PD-4521.

incident-bot: Incident PD-4521 moved to "mitigated" by alice-oncall. Next update in 45m or on escalation.
